raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, and related parts should re-verify ECCN classification and license exceptions, confirm US HTS alignment for the 9302/9303 lines, and re-screen customers and consignees against the Entity List and restricted party lists. Section 301 tariff exposure and end-use/end-user documentation remain relevant for dual-use or military-adjacent items.
raw.content_zh: 美国工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了《出口管理条例》下民用枪支弹药的许可与分类处理。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪及相关零部件的企业应重新核实ECCN分类与许可例外，确认9302/9303税号与美国HTS的对应关系，并对客户和收货人重新进行实体清单及受限方筛查。对于两用或接近军用的物项，仍需关注301关税风险及最终用途/最终用户文件。

checklist.desc: Re-classify civilian firearms, shotguns, rifles, and parts under the rescinded rule; confirm whether EAR99 or a specific ECCN now applies and document the rationale.
Assess eligibility for license exceptions (e.g., LVS, TSR, or the restored firearms provisions) and confirm value and destination limits before shipment.
Map goods to 10-digit HTS lines under 9302/9303, verify Section 301 list exposure, and retain country-of-origin and value build-up records.
Screen all customers, consignees, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN, and other restricted party lists; retain screening evidence.
Obtain and retain non-military end-use and end-user certifications, especially for items with dual-use or military-adjacent characteristics.
Confirm state-level firearms transfer and marking requirements and any applicable environmental or safety registrations for ammunition components.
